title: Expose immiscible interface state
scope: Add a separately queryable interface mode and typed, versioned capillary state for immiscible fluid pairs; advertise nothing.
acceptance: Registry, generated C API and specification define the interface capability identity, first-to-second normal convention, surface tension in N/m and the zero limit.
Negative tests atomically reject interface state on other material profiles plus missing, negative, nonfinite, duplicate and unsupported state.
